lean.statement:
theorem IsLocalMin.deriv_deriv_nonneg_of_continuousAt
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x : ℝ} (hmin : IsLocalMin f x)
    (hc : ContinuousAt f x) :
    0 ≤ deriv (deriv f) x
approved_definition_context: IsLocalMin f x means f(x) is no larger than f(y) for all y in some neighborhood of x.
ContinuousAt f x is continuity at the extremum.
Mathlib deriv is a total real derivative operator, returning zero when differentiability is unavailable.
